entries.reason: the 10.0.1 release already exports this name and its value is the one measured here, so on every band the port builds for the release's own symbol answers and carrying it is the band's; the registry's introduced is the release that first exports it, not Apple's later header annotation, because carried is introduced <= deployment
entries.effect: answers the string the framework itself answers for this name, "mdta/com.apple.quicktime.is-montage" - a key or an object type an application writes into a metadata item and gets back as the identifier it was given
entries.source: dyld.first_releases over the armv7/armv7s ladder, and a direct dump of the exports of the arm64 caches of 9.3.6, 10.0.1, 11.0 and 12.0 and the arm64e cache of 16.0 (tools/corpus/dump-cache.lua), with _NSFileSize planted as a control: it answers 3.0 on the armv7 ladder and 7.0 on the arm64 one, so a run that answers nothing for it is a broken measurement and not an answer of 'no release exports this'; and the value itself by the host differential in tests/backports/host/avf-metadata, which reads the table out of two builds - Apple's framework alone and the port's objects beside it in one binary with the names renamed - and diffs it, the text and the bytes both
